title: Bifrost platform
description: The Ray platform Bifrost runs: what is up, who is using it, what each cluster is doing, what the gateway sees, and the control plane and machine underneath. Every series carries the labels Bifrost stamps on pods (cluster, owner), so everything here slices by tenant.

panels.title: Clusters running
panels.description: Clusters the control plane currently observes as running.

panels.title: Ray nodes up
panels.description: Head and worker pods answering their metrics scrape, across every cluster Bifrost provisions.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Ray jobs in flight, summed over every cluster's GCS.

panels.title: CPUs in use
panels.description: Logical CPUs Ray has handed to tasks and actors right now, all clusters.

panels.title: API requests / s
panels.description: Requests reaching the Bifrost API through the platform gateway (5-minute rate).

panels.title: API 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of API responses that were 5xx at the gateway. Green under 1%, serious above 5%.

panels.title: Cluster records by project
panels.description: Every record Bifrost holds, by project — including stopped clusters that have not been purged yet, so a big number is history as much as it is load. (bifrost_clusters_by_project carries no state label; when it does, this becomes live clusters only.)

panels.title: Live clusters by state
panels.description: Clusters with an observed state, over time. Stopped records that await purge report no state and are counted in the tile to the right, not here — there are enough of them to flatten this chart into its axis otherwise.

panels.title: Ray nodes per cluster
panels.description: Heads and workers over time — the shape a scale-up and scale-down would draw. With Bifrost run without --ray-autoscaling this is flat by design.

panels.title: CPUs in use, by owner
panels.description: Logical CPUs Ray reports as used, attributed to the cluster owner Bifrost stamped on the pods.

panels.title: Memory in use, by owner
panels.description: Ray's memory resource in use, per owner.

panels.title: Metered usage, by project
panels.description: Bifrost's own meter — what the usage report and cost estimates are built from (sampled every --metering-interval).

panels.title: CPU utilisation — $cluster
panels.description: Per-node CPU utilisation as Ray measures it. A head pinned at 100% under a job ramp is the driver-per-job ceiling.

panels.title: Memory used — $cluster
panels.description: Per-node memory used, with the node total for scale. Heads that approach the total under load are heads about to be OOM-killed.

panels.title: Tasks by state — $cluster
panels.description: Live Ray scheduler task states. Cancelled is a lifetime count and is left out — it drew a wall over everything else. Waiting climbing while Executing stays flat means the cluster is out of capacity for this load.

panels.title: Jobs — $cluster
panels.description: Jobs in flight and the rate they finish at.

panels.title: Object store — $cluster
panels.description: Plasma object store in use against its capacity; spilling begins when used meets capacity.

panels.title: Actors — $cluster
panels.description: Actor lifecycle counts from GCS.

panels.title: Requests / s by route
panels.description: bifrost-route is the API, bifrost-ui-route the dashboard, bifrost-gateway-wildcard the per-cluster Ray Jobs gateway.

panels.title: Responses by class — API
panels.description: Status classes the API answered with, as the gateway saw them.

panels.title: API latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Upstream request time at the gateway, in milliseconds.

panels.title: Bifrost CPU
panels.description: The API + reconciler process, in millicores.

panels.title: Bifrost memory
panels.description: Working set of the control-plane container.

panels.title: Container restarts in the bifrost namespace
panels.description: Restarts per hour, per container. A Ray head that restarts under a job ramp shows here first.

panels.title: Pods in bifrost by phase
panels.description: Every pod in the namespace — clusters, jobs, the control plane, the requirements runner.

panels.title: Node CPU
panels.description: Whole-node CPU busy fraction (node-exporter).

panels.title: Node memory
panels.description: Memory used against the node total.

panels.title: CPU requested in the bifrost namespace
panels.description: What the namespace has reserved from the scheduler, against what the node can give. The gap is the room clusters can still grow into.

panels.title: Unpurged
panels.description: Stopped clusters Bifrost still holds a record for (observed state none). Bookkeeping, not load; a purge clears them.
